name: Can I add a primary suite to a single-story home?

mainEntity.name: Can I add a primary suite to a single-story home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can add a primary suite to a single-story home. This can be achieved through a ground-level extension, building out from an existing wall, or by converting and expanding an underutilized area like a garage, if feasible. Another option, depending on structural integrity and zoning, is to add a second story, creating a new primary suite level above the existing footprint. The best approach depends on your lot size, local regulations, and desired outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can add a primary suite to a single-story home via a ground-level extension or, if suitable, a second-story addition.
